headline: Island Sectors Flare as Inland Fronts Settle into Attrition
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the tactical picture has shifted dramatically as coastal and island sectors reignited while inland cauldrons settled into grueling attrition. Stlican Shelf and Fisherman’s Row, previously cooled, flared back to life with eleven combined base transactions over the past two hours, driven by renewed clashes over Breaker Town, Eidolo, and Black Well. Along the northern tier, the furious base-swapping in Weathered Expanse has ebbed to a solitary shift in the latest two hours, yet bloodletting continues unabated as Warden losses surge past seven hundred per hour around Frostmarch and Wightwalk. Callahan’s Passage has similarly halted its rapid territorial changes, leaving Warden forces in total control of its ten strategic bases while combined casualties begin to taper. Instead, fresh instability has broken out across the Nevish Line and Palantine Berm, which logged three base flips apiece in the past two hours amid fierce struggles for Grief Mother, Tomb Father, and Leiri Hermanni. Farther west, Mooring County remains a meatgrinder of heavy draft calls despite no recent movement in line ownership.
